item.title: 4,400-Mile 2006 Chevrolet SSR 6-Speed
item.description: This 2006 Chevrolet SSR is finished in Pacific Blue Metallic with a white center stripe over Ebony leather and powered by a 6.0-liter V8 linked to a six-speed manual transmission and a Torsen limited-slip differential. Equipment includes a power-retractable hardtop, a hardshell tonneau cover, a ZQ8 sport suspension, four-wheel disc brakes, chrome 19" and 20" five-spoke wheels, power-adjustable seats, air conditioning, cruise control, a CD stereo, a K&N air intake, and aftermarket exhaust headers

item.title: 22k-Mile 2010 Mazda MX-5 Miata Grand Touring PRHT 6-Speed at No Reserve
item.description: This 2010 Mazda MX-5 Miata Grand Touring was first delivered to Baglier Mazda in Butler, Pennsylvania. It has 22k miles following registration history in the state, and it remained in the original owner's care until September 2024. The car is finished in Copper Red Mica over Dune Beige leather and is powered by a 2.0-liter inline-four paired with a six-speed manual transmission. item.title: 32k-Mile 1992 Dodge Stealth R/T Turbo 5-Speed at No Reserve
item.description: This 1992 Dodge Stealth R/T Turbo shows 32k miles and is powered by a twin-turbocharged 3.0-liter DOHC V6 that drives all four wheels through a five-speed manual transaxle. Finished in Jet Black over black leather, the car is equipped with a rear spoiler, pop-up headlights, a rear window wiper, 17" aluminum Ultimate wheels, a CD/cassette stereo, a leather-wrapped steering wheel, cruise control, and automatic climate control. item.description: This 2003 Porsche Boxster S is powered by a 3.2-liter flat-six paired with a six-speed manual transaxle and is finished in Arctic Silver Metallic over black leather. Equipment includes a black soft top, a speed-activated rear spoiler, 18" Carrera-style wheels, aftermarket headlights and taillights, heated seats, a CD stereo, a Bose sound system, cruise control, and automatic climate control. item.title: 409-Powered 1965 Chevrolet Impala SS Sport Coupe 4-Speed
item.description: This 1965 Chevrolet Impala SS is a blue-on-blue sport coupe that was produced by GM of Canada and is powered by a replacement 409ci V8 backed by a four-speed manual transmission and a 12-bolt rear end. The car rides on 15" Rally-style wheels and has chrome bumpers, 409 badging, and a dual exhaust system with Dynomax Super Turbo mufflers as well as front bucket seats, a push-button radio, and a Hurst shifter. item.title: 37k-Mile Modified 2004 Chevrolet Corvette Z06 Commemorative Edition
item.description: This 2004 Chevrolet Corvette Z06 is one of 2,025 Commemorative Edition models produced to celebrate the C5-R's class victories at the 24 Hours of Le Mans. It has 37k miles and is modified with an aftermarket camshaft, a roll cage, Wilwood brakes, Dynatech headers, a FAST intake manifold, a Hurricane air intake, a short-throw shifter, a Borla exhaust, and 18" split-spoke wheels.
